about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply: If you love live music and nights out, you might enjoy [[Music]], [[Rock]], or [[Vocaloid]]. Have you had a look at the [[Gigs]] page to see what is coming up?

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: That sounds like a lovely way to spend an evening. Based on what you enjoy, you might like [[Gaming and Roleplay]], [[Book]], or [[Film]].

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply:
Since you are into football and running, you might like [[Climbing]] or [[Outdoor Climbing]] for a new physical challenge, or [[Walking]] if you enjoy a more relaxed pace. 

Have a look at [[Sport]] as well to see all the sports clubs and teams you can join.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply:
If you love the cinema, you might enjoy [[Film]]. 

What kind of films do you usually like to watch?

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: For gaming, you might like [[Esports]] or [[Video Game]], which are great ways to meet others with similar hobbies. Have you had a look at your checklist yet?

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply:
If you love big nights out, clubbing and festivals, take a look at NSU's [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] pages. 

What kind of music or nightlife do you usually enjoy most?

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: That sounds like a great way to spend the morning. For those activities, you might like [[Climbing]], [[Outdoor Climbing]] or [[Walking]].

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply: For knitting, [[Hooked By Crochet]] is a great fit for crafts, and for birdwatching and nature, [[Conservation of Fine Art]] or [[Geography]] might interest you. Take a look at the Societies page to see all the options available.

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Thanks for letting me know what you prefer to avoid. What sort of things do you enjoy doing in your spare time?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: If you enjoy reading and films, you might like [[Book]] or [[Film]]. Have a look at the Societies page to see what else might take your fancy.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply: If you are into live music, you might like [[Music]].

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: You can definitely join [[Ukrainian]], as everyone is welcome to take part and share in the culture. Have a look at the Societies page for more details.

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: It is completely normal to feel that way, and there is a society specifically for people in the same boat called [[Mature Students]]. You can also take a look at the Societies page to browse all the options available. Is there a particular hobby or interest you enjoy in your spare time?

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: Money worries can be really stressful, but you do not have to handle them alone. Have a look at [[Cost of Living]] for help with food and laptop loans, and [[Advice Centre]] for guidance on financial issues.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am really sorry to hear you are dealing with that worry, but there is support available right away. You can use [[Food Pantry]] to book a ticket for free food, and take a look at [[Cost of Living]] for more help with money worries.

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: Try not to panic, as help is available. You can contact the [[Advice Centre]] for confidential guidance on academic misconduct and how to handle the situation.

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply: That sounds really frustrating, and you definitely deserve a proper place to live. Have a look at the [[Advice Centre]] for guidance on housing issues and how to raise a complaint.
